purpose: Four selectable color themes for the existing editable K105 journal-club layouts. Scientific source images retain their original colors.
supporting_color_policy: Source primary colors are preserved exactly. New theme light backgrounds, rules and muted reverse text are sRGB blends with white (10%, 40%, 20% primary respectively); neutrals stay consistent. Existing blue support colors are preserved for compatibility. No institution logos or defense-specific content are imported.
